name: Spiky Pit Trap
disable: DC 18 Thievery check (trained) to manually trigger the trap without falling in, or DC 25 Thievery check (trained) to secure the hide so the trap doesn't activate.
reset: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the hide that covers it must be reset manually (a 10-minute activity) for the trap to become hidden again.

items.name: Pitfall
items.text:
Trigger A creature or other large weight (such as the rushing waters of the previous trap) moves onto the gravel-covered hide

---

Effect The triggering creature or object falls in and takes falling damage (10 bludgeoning damage) and is targeted by a spike's Strike. A falling creature can attempt to Grab an Edge with a DC 20 Reflex save save (this becomes a DC 22 Reflex save save if rushing waters are pouring into the pit).

text: A piece of hide covered with a layer of dirt and gravel is suspended over a 20-foot pit filled with spikes.
